answer: Sybil resistance can start with a one-time bonded watch. A newcomer posts a refundable stake and is assigned a unique coastal jetty sensor, then must log an unrepeatable observation—such as the flight line of a marked sparrow against a calibrated glacier backdrop—signed with arrival times peers can audit. Copycat identities share the same vantage and fail the uniqueness check, so cheap replicas never accumulate voting power.
